summary: IDA jump thunk: forwards the __thiscall this argument to RenderResourceTeardown and returns its result unchanged. No logic of its own. Referenced by NetworkPacketSendReceive and SurfaceBlitOperation.

operations.description: Forward this to RenderResourceTeardown(this); the thunk tail-jumps so the callee's return value propagates unchanged.
Return the result produced by RenderResourceTeardown.
Referenced by NetworkPacketSendReceive as the teardown entry point used from the network send/receive path.
Referenced by SurfaceBlitOperation as the teardown entry point used from the surface blit path.

unresolved: RenderResourceTeardown itself is not listed in the packet callee table, so its address and behavior are not confirmed from this evidence.
The identity of the object type behind this is unknown; the thunk imposes no constraints.
